title: Practice 10: либо, или … или, то … то, не то … не то

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Shark soup or whale steak? You have the choice.
exercises.ru: Акулий суп ___ китовый стейк? У вас есть выбор.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Nuclear bombs are made from uranium or plutonium.
exercises.ru: Атомные бомбы делают из урана ___ плутония.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Are pigs fat or do farmers overfeed them?
exercises.ru: Свиньи толстые ___ фермеры их перекармливают?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Are there more water or land animals?

exercises.q: Are you a liberal or conservative?

exercises.q: Tom says he'll do that whether it's legal or not.
exercises.ru: Том говорит, что сделает это, неважно, легально это ___ нет.

exercises.q: I'd like to drink some tea or coffee.

exercises.q: Does a government have to serve ideologies, or rather, the interests of the people?
exercises.ru: Правительство должно служит идеологии ___, вместо этого, интересам народа?

exercises.q: I don't remember if Don Quixote wore a hat or not.

exercises.q: Is the mouse dead or alive?
exercises.ru: Мышь дохлая ___ живая?

exercises.q: Do you agree with Mr. Burns or do you agree with Mr. Roland?

exercises.q: Did you or did you not accept the bribe?

exercises.q: Do you prefer Coke or Pepsi?

exercises.q: But if it be from the sick, or if it be in any way soiled, clean it.

exercises.q: Are newts and salamanders amphibians or reptiles?
exercises.ru: Тритоны и саламандры — это земноводные ___ пресмыкающиеся?

exercises.q: Horus was often depicted as a falcon, or as a man with a falcon head.

exercises.q: The subscriber's device is turned off, or is outside the network coverage area.

exercises.q: She became pale and flushed by turns.

exercises.q: "A" logo is a trademark or registered trademark of A Corporation.
exercises.ru: Логотип "А" - это товарный знак ___ зарегистрированная торговая марка "А корпорации".
